name: MoleculeNet
description: A benchmark suite of molecular machine-learning datasets spanning quantum mechanics, physical chemistry, biophysics, and physiology. Molecules are represented as graphs and datasets include property-prediction tasks such as classification and regression. This record is metadata-only and does not distribute data.
citation: Wu, Z., Ramsundar, B., Feinberg, E. N., Gomes, J., Geniesse, C., Pappu, A. S., Leswing, K., & Pande, V. (2018). MoleculeNet: a benchmark for molecular machine learning. Chemical Science, 9, 513–530. https://doi.org/10.1039/C7SC02664A

license.identifier: Dataset-specific terms (not a standard SPDX identifier)
license.notes: MoleculeNet aggregates datasets with source-specific terms; the benchmark does not establish one standard SPDX license for the entire suite. Review the terms for each constituent dataset before use or redistribution. No data is vendored.
